parsed.headline: Claim denied: Insulin regimen requirement not met for CGM coverage.
parsed.explanation: This claim is denied because it does not meet the following policy requirement: "The beneficiary is insulin-treated with multiple (three or more) daily injections of insulin or a Medicare-covered continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion (CSII) pump; and,". The record shows zero daily insulin injections and the CSII pump is not Medicare-covered.
parsed.what_to_do: No action needed unless you have documentation showing three or more daily insulin injections or a Medicare-covered CSII pump.
